title: Frijolero
lyrics:
[00:28.12]Yo ya estoy hasta la madre de que me pongan sombrero
[00:33.97]Escuche entonces cuando digo
[00:35.42]No me llames frijolero
[00:36.46]Y aunque exista algún respeto, no metamos las narices
[00:43.60]Nunca inflamos la moneda
[00:44.77]Haciendo guerra a otros países
[00:47.73]Te pagamos con petróleo o intereses nuestra deuda
[00:54.06]Mientras tanto no sabemos
[00:56.36]Quién se queda con la feria
[00:59.01]Aunque nos hagan la fama de que somos vendedores
[01:02.59]De la droga que sembramos
[01:05.63]Ustedes son consumidores
[01:09.12]Don't call me gringo, you fuckin' beaner
[01:11.57]Stay on your side of that goddamn river
[01:13.92]Don't call me gringo, you beaner
[01:19.34]No me digas beaner, Mr. Puñetero
[01:21.14]Te sacaré un susto por racista y culero
[01:24.03]No me llames frijolero, pinche gringo puñetero
[01:28.29]Chingao
[01:32.89]Now I wish I had a dime for every single time
[01:35.39]I've gotten stared down for being in the wrong side of town
[01:38.06]And a rich man I'd be If I had that kind of chips
[01:40.56]Lately I wanna smack the mouths of these racists
[01:42.43]Podrás imaginarte desde afuera
[01:46.44]Ser un mexicano cruzando la frontera
[01:47.74]Pensando en tu familia, mientras que pasas
[01:50.52]Dejando todo lo que tú conoces atrás
[01:53.57]Tuvieras tú que esquivar las balas
[01:55.48]De unos cuantos gringos rancheros
[01:58.40]¿Le seguirás diciendo "good for nothing, wetback"?
[02:00.34]Si tuvieras tú, que empezar de cero
[02:02.70]Now, why don't you look down to where your feet is planted?
[02:05.27]That U.S. soil that makes you take shit for granted
[02:07.86]If not for Santa Ana, just to let you know
[02:09.97]That where your feet are planted, would be Mexico
[02:12.67]¿Correcto?
[02:13.63]Don't call me gringo, you fuckin' beaner
[02:15.90]Stay on your side of that goddamn river
[02:18.33]Don't call me gringo, you beaner
[02:23.71]No me digas beaner, Mr. Puñetero
[02:25.52]Te sacaré un susto por racista y culero
[02:28.43]No me llames frijolero, pinche gringo puñetero
[03:02.74]Don't call me gringo, you fuckin' beaner
[03:05.14]Stay on your side of the goddamn river
[03:07.51]Don't call me gringo, you beaner
[03:12.96]No me digas beaner, Mr. Puñetero
[03:15.38]Te sacaré un susto por racista y culero
[03:17.76]No me llames frijolero, pinche gringo
[03:21.69](Pinche gringo, ¿qué?)
[03:23.37]¡Puñetero!
